query: INSERT INTO pages_cache (page_id, title, title_sort_key, last_edited_ms, space_id, updated_at) SELECT json_extract(value, '$[0]'), json_extract(value, '$[1]'), json_extract(value, '$[2]'), json_extract(value, '$[3]'), json_extract(value, '$[4]'), ?1 FROM json_each(?2) WHERE true ON CONFLICT(page_id) DO UPDATE SET title          = excluded.title, title_sort_key = excluded.title_sort_key, last_edited_ms = MAX(pages_cache.last_edited_ms, excluded.last_edited_ms), space_id       = excluded.space_id, updated_at     = CASE WHEN pages_cache.title != excluded.title THEN excluded.updated_at ELSE pages_cache.updated_at END WHERE pages_cache.title != excluded.title OR pages_cache.title_sort_key != excluded.title_sort_key OR pages_cache.last_edited_ms < excluded.last_edited_ms OR pages_cache.space_id IS NOT excluded.space_id
